summary: Super League Enterprise filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026, disclosing under Item 8.01 that on October 10, 2026 it made an inaugural purchase of one Bitcoin for $83,041.40, part of its exploration of Bitcoin as a treasury asset alongside cash and cash equivalents. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, stake, or transaction counterparty is named; the disclosure is a routine other-events update with no deal mechanics, regulatory clock, or overhang. The risk-arb angle is nil, though treasury-strategy disclosures may draw investor scrutiny.
